title: SentinelFlow event envelope, v1
description:
The outer structure every SentinelFlow event carries, on every topic, without exception. Everything here is transport and provenance; the event-specific body is `payload`. Defined in ADR-0006.

This schema is versioned as a whole and separately from payloads: `schemaVersion` describes the payload contract for a given `eventType`, not this envelope. Changing the envelope itself would mean a v2 envelope and a coordinated migration, which is exactly why it carries nothing that varies by event.

eventId.description: Unique identity for this event. Consumers deduplicate on it, because delivery is at-least-once and a duplicate is normal traffic rather than an incident.

eventType.description: What happened. Lets a consumer route and dispatch without parsing the payload.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the payload contract for this eventType. A consumer must be able to tell what it is holding before it reads it.

occurredAt.description: When the fact happened - NOT when it was published. Replay depends on the difference.

correlationId.description: Ties every event, log line and span originating from one request together. Propagated unchanged across service boundaries.

traceId.description: W3C trace context trace-id, 32 lower-case hex characters, or null when no trace is active. Null rather than absent, so a consumer never has to distinguish 'not traced' from 'field forgotten'.

aggregateType.description: The kind of entity this event is about. With aggregateId, identifies the subject without any payload knowledge.

aggregateId.description: Identity of the entity this event is about.

payload.description:
The event-specific body. Its shape is defined by the schema for this eventType at this schemaVersion.

Never contains a secret, a credential, a token, or personal data. Events are long-lived, replayable, and readable by anything with topic access.
